description: Use when the user asks how big or how small a kind of tattoo can be, or what fits at a given size. Returns the smallest and better size for eight kinds of design (letters by height, other designs by longest side), real-world size comparisons and the small/medium/large ranges. Optional size_cm marks which designs meet their minimum at that size.

size_cm.description: Optional size in centimetres to look up what fits.

name: get_tattoo_size_chart
title: Get the tattoo size chart
